name: dashboard_default
label: Default Dashboard Table
description: The default dashboard table is used for related queries and report queries related to dashboards.

fields.name: dashboard_id
fields.description: Dashboard unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_uuid
fields.description: Dashboard users, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Dashboard type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the dashboard_id, user_uuid, type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_uuid_userid_type
indexes.description: Standard index covering the dashboard_id, user_uuid, type fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
